title: Deinterleave channels and planes
description: Puts frames of several channels and planes, interleaved in one stack (channel fastest, then plane, as ScanImage saves them), in a height x width x channels (x planes) x frames stack, which the other methods take a channel and plane of. Frames after the last whole volume are left out. Reads and writes a chunk at a time.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: Deinterleaved stack
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.
